tex_content.label: prop:universal-covering-manifold
tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Existence of a Universal Covering Manifold] 1. chA:A.60[LeeSM, Cor. 4.31] If $M$ is a connected smooth manifold, then there exists a simply connected smooth manifold $\tilde{M}$, called the universal covering manifold of $M$, and a smooth covering map $\pi : \tilde{M} \to M$. It is unique in the sense that if $\tilde{M}'$ is any other simply connected smooth manifold that admits a smooth covering map $\pi ': \tilde{M}' \to M$, then there exists a diffeomorphism $\Phi : \tilde{M} \to \tilde{M}'$ such that $\pi ' \circ \Phi = \pi $.
